gaps.title: Missing stable identifiers (UUID/stable_id)
gaps.description: All agents rely on string IDs without UUIDs. Renaming an agent breaks external references.
gaps.recommendation: Add uuid field to AGENT_REGISTRY.yaml for all agents

gaps.title: Incomplete agent metadata
gaps.description: Some agents missing required fields for canonical identification
gaps.recommendation: Audit and complete agent_context.json with missing fields

inconsistencies.title: Non-kebab-case agent ID
inconsistencies.description: Agent 'codex_reviewer' uses underscore instead of kebab-case naming convention
inconsistencies.impact: Naming inconsistency complicates pattern matching and discovery

gaps.title: No canonical track/campaign registry
gaps.description: Phases, tracks, waves, and lanes are defined as ad-hoc files without central registry
gaps.issue: No programmatic way to enumerate or validate execution hierarchy
gaps.recommendation: Create PHASE_REGISTRY.yaml, TRACK_REGISTRY.yaml with stable IDs and parent references

gaps.title: Missing parent-child hierarchy documentation
gaps.recommendation: Create HIERARCHY_MAPPING.yaml with explicit parent_id references

gaps.title: No canonical deliverable registry
gaps.description: No central registry for deliverables with versioned records
gaps.issue: Cannot audit deliverable creation, version history, or dependencies
gaps.recommendation: Create DELIVERABLE_MANIFEST.yaml with version, created_at, created_by fields

gaps.title: No workflow identity scheme
gaps.description: Workflows lack stable identifiers - only file names available
gaps.issue: Cannot reliably reference workflows across CI/CD configuration
gaps.recommendation: Add workflow_id field to all workflows using deterministic scheme (e.g., sha256 of path)

gaps.title: No script/utility identity scheme
gaps.description: Scripts lack explicit ID pattern or registry
gaps.issue: Cannot programmatically identify script purpose, version, or dependencies
gaps.recommendation: Add __script_id__ and __version__ module-level constants to all scripts

cross_reference_issues.issue: Documentation references agents not in AGENT_REGISTRY.yaml
